title: Tiered Memory Management Beyond Hotness
problem: Current memory tiering systems (fast/slow) only consider hotness/access frequency, missing other important factors for placement decisions
motivation: Effective memory tiering can significantly reduce cost and improve performance of large-scale AI systems; beyond-hotness approaches better capture real workload characteristics
method: Advanced memory tiering management considering factors beyond access hotness
key_novelty: First memory tiering system to move beyond simple hotness-based policies
contributions: Improved placement decisions for multi-tier memory
hardware_target: Systems with multi-tier memory (DRAM, NVMe, disk)
limitations: Title-only paper; specific factors and policies not described; experimental results not provided
